# Detector v2 data split — the 56 days become development-only

> **Binding rule.** The 56 days below are hereby classified
> `measurement_protocol_development_set`. They may be used to design Detector v2. They may
> **not** be used as validation evidence for it.
>
> Detector v1 was invalidated by a property of these same days — severe nonstationarity. Any
> detector built to survive that property has, by construction, been fitted to them. Judging
> it on them would be measuring how well it remembers, not whether it works.

## 1. What is preserved unchanged

The previous verdict stands exactly as recorded in
[HAMPTON_ROADS_DETECTABILITY.md](HAMPTON_ROADS_DETECTABILITY.md):

```
HAMPTON_ROADS_LOW_POWER
```

**Reason:** failed under the fixed-level anomaly protocol because severe baseline
nonstationarity invalidated a pooled level threshold.

That document is not rewritten, not relabelled, and not deleted. Detector v1 failed. The
failure is the reason Detector v2 exists, and it stays on the record as a failure.

## 2. Permitted uses of the development set

| Permitted | Forbidden |
|---|---|
| measure secular trend magnitude | any validation claim for Detector v2 |
| measure short-term variability | any false-positive rate quoted as evidence |
| measure autocorrelation | tuning after blind data is seen |
| estimate occupancy scale | establishing detectability |
| study entry/exit behaviour | |
| study dwell distributions | |
| identify measurement pathologies | |

Every Detector v2 parameter — lookback, residual threshold, persistence, scale floor,
coverage-guard ratio — is chosen from these days and then frozen. Nothing may be revised
once blind data exists.

## 3. Sampled windows

Frozen rule: one 7-day window per quarter, starting on the 15th of the quarter's middle
month, 2020-Q3 → 2022-Q2.

| Window | Days |
|---|---|
| 2020-Q3 | 2020-08-15 → 2020-08-21 |
| 2020-Q4 | 2020-11-15 → 2020-11-21 |
| 2021-Q1 | 2021-02-15 → 2021-02-21 |
| 2021-Q2 | 2021-05-15 → 2021-05-21 |
| 2021-Q3 | 2021-08-15 → 2021-08-21 |
| 2021-Q4 | 2021-11-15 → 2021-11-21 |
| 2022-Q1 | 2022-02-15 → 2022-02-21 |
| 2022-Q2 | 2022-05-15 → 2022-05-21 |

**Acquisition totals:** 56 of 56 days, zero missing, zero failures.
17,119,449,154 bytes of national AIS transferred (17.12 GB), 445,632,077 national rows
scanned, 836,886 regional rows retained.

## 5. Non-overlap obligation

The Detector v2 blind sample must contain **no day listed above**. The proof is recorded in
[HAMPTON_ROADS_DETECTOR_V2_BLIND_SAMPLE.md](HAMPTON_ROADS_DETECTOR_V2_BLIND_SAMPLE.md) and
asserted by a test, not left to inspection.
